scope: Kindergarten and Grades1–6, primary through age12. Higher grades and historical older bands preserved but not new authoring scope.
inventoryMeaning: 2768 catalogue records include overall/specific expectations and programme variants; they are not distinct skills. Linked counts are inventory, not coverage or a completion percentage.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: French as a Second Language, 2013
sources.reviewState: Unreviewed alignment scope. Programme variants require actual French listening/speaking/reading/writing competence; English analogues do not satisfy them.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Health and Physical Education, 2019
sources.reviewState: Unreviewed alignment scope. Separate health knowledge from observable movement, interpersonal and practical performance; no blanket PE exclusion assumed.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Kindergarten, 2026
sources.reviewState: Integrated Kindergarten audit pending; inherited foundation links do not establish its cross-area requirements.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Language, 2023
sources.reviewState: Accepted Grades1–6 work and Grades1–4 reconciliation exist; inherited judgments remain distinguished from fresh clause/source checks. Resource and keyboarding conditions remain.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Mathematics, 2020
sources.reviewState: Accepted primary associations and historical focused reviews exist. This inventory does not freshly recertify every mandatory clause; Grade1 evidence recovery remains separately traceable.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Native Languages, 2001
sources.reviewState: Unreviewed alignment scope. Identify the actual target Indigenous language, orthography, speaker/community resources and performance; generic English or cultural recognition is insufficient.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Science and Technology, 2022
sources.reviewState: Accepted Grades1–6 audit and cross-grade residual review exist. Practical/integrated tasks, resources, whole-claim fit and readiness conditions remain; links do not imply Full.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: Social Studies, History, and Geography, 2026
sources.reviewState: Current Grade1 proposal reviews39 records, with specific missing-knowledge and task conditions. Grades2–6 remain unreviewed alignment scope.

sources.name: The Ontario Curriculum: The Arts, 2009
sources.reviewState: Unreviewed alignment scope. Separate discipline knowledge from actual creation, performance, response and cultural-resource conditions.

nextSlices: Resolve bounded Grade1 Social Studies knowledge decisions while reviewing Grade2 independently.
Continue Social Studies Grades2–6, retaining localized history/civics knowledge and evidence conditions.
Audit Arts, Health/PE and integrated Kindergarten as separate coherent scopes.
Establish genuine French/Indigenous-language source and competence support before claiming those language expectations.
completionStatement: Ontario primary integration is not complete. Current audit completion and Full coverage must be reported separately; no source or subject is called complete from associations alone.
